evidence.quote: The ink composition contains a dispersion medium and charged particles containing at least a colorant. The charged particle includes at least one kind of polymer having a repeating unit of a specific structure.

This inkjet recording apparatus 1 includes: a processing fluid applying part 12 which applies a processing fluid containing a flocculant on the recording medium 22; a drawing part 14 which applies the plurality of inks which contain a pigment particle (A), a dispersion agent polymer (B) for covering the pigment, and a self-dispersing polymer fine particle (C), where the total amount (B+C) of the polymer component occupies one half or more amount to the total solid component amount (A+B+C), and at the same time, which have different total solid component amounts to the recording medium 22; and a drying part 16 which makes solvents contained in the plurality of inks volatilize.
The liquid composition for inkjet contains at least an organic acid having a ring-shaped structure, an organic compound having the ring-shaped structure, a water-soluble solvent and water.
